marks.gloss_en: if the yevama, not acquired by money, is acquired by intercourse, then the Hebrew maidservant, who is acquired by money -- is it not logical that she is acquired by intercourse?
a yevama is not acquired by money
מה ליבמה שכן זקוקה ועומדת -- the yevama is already bound and standing to the yavam; no such bond precedes the maidservant's acquisition
הואיל וכתיב אם אחרת יקח לו, הקישה הכתוב לאחרת: as 'another' (a wife) is acquired by intercourse, so the Hebrew maidservant
קא משמע לן ובעלה -- this one is acquired by intercourse, and the Hebrew maidservant is not
מתקיף לה: if betrothal needed money and then intercourse, the betrothed na'arah whom the Torah stones is unfindable -- bedded, she is no virgin; unbedded, there is no betrothal
the Torah's law: one who lies with a betrothed virgin na'arah is stoned (Deut 22:23-24)
betrothed with a document, which completes her entry as it completes her exit -- betrothed, and still a virgin
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: find it where he betrothed her with a document -- as a document completes her exit, it completes her entry, with no intercourse
ומי אית ליה לרבי האי סברא? והתניא: ten men and she is still a virgin -- Rebbi says the first is stoned and the rest strangled
a woman is acquired (betrothed) with intercourse -- the mishna's law
(entertained) from 'u-ve'alah' alone: she is not his wife unless he betroths with money and then cohabits -- intercourse alone would not betroth
the Rabbis before Abaye: find it where the betrothed man cohabited with her atypically -- betrothal complete, virginity intact
the husband renders her a non-virgin even by atypical intercourse -- by all opinions (Abaye; and Rebbi's own derivation at 9b.20)
another man does NOT render her a non-virgin by atypical intercourse (Rebbi's reading of בעולת בעל)
first tanna: ten men came upon her (atypically) while she remains a virgin -- all are stoned
a Hebrew maidservant is not acquired by intercourse -- what 'u-ve'alah' comes to exclude
Rava (from bar Ahina): only betrothal that can be consummated is betrothal
